comments.author: @americanoutrage1204
comments.text: Consumers hold real power in a capitalist system. If you are unhappy with a company’s products or practices, you simply stop buying them. When enough people make that choice, the company loses revenue and must either accept the losses or correct the problem that is driving customers away. It is inconsistent to criticize the greatest economic system in history while continuing to purchase from the very companies you claim have too much money. Responsibility rests with the consumer, and it is compounded by the large numbers of illegal immigrants who increase demand and push prices higher through ordinary supply and demand. As long as customers keep buying, companies will keep supplying the goods and services. Complaining about capitalism while millions cross the border ready to take available positions ignores this basic reality. Ask Cubans, or citizens of any country that has lived under socialism or communism, which system has served them better. Americans should be thanking God they live in this country. It is hard to feel sympathy for people who regularly order delivery several times a week and maintain multiple subscriptions they rarely use. Greater personal financial responsibility is needed before criticizing free markets. Without a proper grounding in real history and economics, rather than what many government schools have taught, people risk learning these lessons the hard way
